context: Daichi takes a brave step at work; tells Mei about it.
purpose: Husband sharing courageous workplace decision with wife.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: メイ、今日、上司に意見、言ったわ。
lines.en: Mei — I told the boss what I actually thought today.
lines.style: Warm, slightly chest-proud energy on the opener. Kansai lilt, soft and unpracticed at boasting. Steady pace, like he's still settling into the smallness of what he did. Eye contact seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Soft, genuine approval. No performance in it. Tilts toward him slightly. Warm breath on the opening syllable, like she's breathing out admiration.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: My heart was pounding the whole time.
lines.style: Quieter confession now. The bravado settling into honesty. Kansai warmth but vulnerable. Small laugh buried in there — the relief of admitting he was terrified.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Steady, affirming. Not big emotions — just solid ground. She's meeting him where he is. Warm on the second half, like she's tucking something protective into the words.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I actually went through with it.
lines.style: Small wonder in his voice. Kansai warmth, almost surprised at himself. Softer, like he's still processing. Slight exhale of relief underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Tender, unhurried. Each word given its own weight. No rush to move past it. Looks at him like she's seeing something she loves.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I couldn't have done it without you.
lines.style: Kansai softness, genuine gratitude without heaviness. Not performing sacrifice — just stating a small, warm truth. The kind of thing you say to someone who's been quietly standing next to you.
